name: Eagle Point Solar
old_description: Solar Projects for Agriculture, Commercial, Residential, Municipal, Utility and Academic Industries
about:
Eagle Point Solar is based in Dubuque, Iowa, and serves customers across Iowa, Illinois, and Wisconsin. The company operates as a turnkey solar contractor, handling projects from initial design through installation and ongoing support.

The firm provides end-to-end solar energy solutions, including site assessment, system design, engineering, permitting, rebate processing, construction, and commissioning. Its Solar Journey process covers residential rooftops, agricultural arrays, commercial and municipal buildings, academic campuses, and utility-scale installations. The company also integrates battery backup systems and offers a dedicated service and support team for post-installation maintenance.

Eagle Point Solar works with a range of public and private sector clients. Municipal projects include the Green County Government Services Building, the City of La Crosse Municipal Service Center, City of Asbury, and City of Sun Prairie. Commercial and industrial clients include Nortera and Wired Production Group. Residential installations feature the Moler, Kramer, Sikemma, and Parkin residences. The company also serves agricultural and academic customers.

The company emphasizes a turnkey approach that manages incentives, grants, and equipment depreciation for customers. Its stated differentiators are a trusted team, a tested process, and proven results, with particular expertise in navigating solar incentives and energy grants to reduce project costs.
